title: KL-8 witness: secure-capable program in a project without Secure

pinned_behaviour.import: flag and table sizes stored as catalogue text and as verbatim program attributes; nothing about Secure reported or retained; project model identical
pinned_behaviour.readiness: identical rows, code 'untested' without recorded evidence
pinned_behaviour.planner: identical 8-step memory download plan; program code identical apart from the verbatim secure attributes
pinned_behaviour.access_keys: exhaustive match: no memory-download step kind writes a key; A_Key_Write only via a declared knx-net plan, refused (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS §112)

not_claimed: No Secure semantics, no statement about what a real secure-capable device needs when Secure is not activated; no documented source was found
